call_points.text: Industry volume growth guided at high single digit for FY27, with scooters growing a couple of points more than motorcycles.
Medium-term EBITDA margin guidance of 14-16% reiterated, but management declined to commit to it for the full FY27.
April price hike of about 2% of sale price against high-single-digit BOM, labour and fuel cost inflation.
Q4 material cost inflation was ₹2,100 per unit against a ₹2,000 per unit revenue increase, driving over 100 bps gross margin fall.
Over ₹1,500 Cr capex committed for FY27, all of it for the year, on scooter and EV capacity.
Over ₹700 Cr committed to a global parts centre in South India, roughly doubling parts handling capacity.
Asked for EV revenue and losses for the quarter, management deferred the answer to an offline discussion.
EPR draft impact not quantified; management said pricing is still evolving and retrospective impact is under discussion.

operating_notes.text: April 2026 exports stood at 33,653 units against 16,882 units in April 2025.
Expanded Premia network count to 132 outlets nationwide by adding 70 new touchpoints.
Made an exceptional provision of ₹119 Cr towards New Labour Code implementation.
Hero MotoCorp acquired a stake in Euler Motors, bringing its holding to 36.7%.
FY26 export revenue was around ₹3,500 Cr on 4,02,000 units.
Dealer inventory stood at about 5 weeks at end-FY26, with EV scooter inventory in single-digit days nationally.
Q4 material cost inflation was ₹2,100 per unit against a ₹2,000 per unit revenue increase; April price hike was about 2% of sale price (₹700-3,500 by model).
Launched Super Splendor XTEC 2.0 at ₹86,500 (Ex-Showroom Delhi) with 72 kmpl mileage.
May 2026 dispatches stood at 570,068 units, with domestic retail registrations at 496,957 VAHAN units.
Hero MotoCorp launched India's first E20 to E85 compatible flex-fuel motorcycles, Splendor+ and HF Deluxe.
VIDA EV market share rose to 6.9% in Q1FY27 from 4.6% a year ago, with EV dispatches up 107% to 193k units.
PLI incentive of ₹48 Cr was booked in Q1FY27, with 60% of the EV portfolio eligible and 100% targeted by December 2026.
Parts, accessories and merchandise revenue rose 30% YoY to ₹1,689 Cr in Q1FY27.
Hero MotoCorp launched the Xtreme 160R 4V starting at ₹1.27 Lakh and Xtreme 250R at ₹1.98 Lakh.
